summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, which includes an earnings coverage ratio on subordinated indebtedness for the 12-month period ended April 30, 2026. The filing reports interest requirements of $374 million and earnings before income taxes and interest requirements of $12,561 million, resulting in a coverage ratio of 33.6 times. This is a routine financial disclosure of a Canadian bank under its foreign private issuer requirements. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. The filing serves solely to update the market on CIBC's interest coverage metric.
